name: realtime-avatar-sdk
description: Realtime Avatar SDK — live voice and video characters you can interrupt.

scripts.build: npm run build -w libs/sdk-server && npm run build -w libs/mcp
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run boundary && npm run messages && npm run surface && npm run reachable && npm run spec:verify
scripts.spec: npm run spec:pull && npm run spec:types
scripts.spec:verify: openapi-typescript spec/realtime-avatar.openapi.json -o /tmp/rta-generated-check.ts && diff -q /tmp/rta-generated-check.ts libs/http-client/src/generated/openapi.ts || (echo '\n✗ generated/openapi.ts does not match the vendored spec — run `npm run spec` and commit' && exit 1)
